tool_schema: Defines issue_refund as a Claude tool with an input schema / passes it in the tools parameter (a tool_use flow).
human_approval: A human approves or rejects a specific refund before it executes (pending queue, approval step, review endpoint).
permission_scope: Restricts WHO or WHICH tickets can use the tool: allowlist, roles, verified accounts, scopes, tool only exposed to some requests.
amount_limit: Limits on refund size or frequency: per-refund cap, daily total, rate limit, max refunds per ticket.
audit_log: Records refund attempts/decisions in a log or audit table.
mocked_tests: Adds pytest tests that mock the Claude client or the tool.

backoff_jitter: Retry waits grow between attempts (exponential backoff) and/or include jitter.
idempotency: Makes repeated save_reply writes safe: idempotency key, upsert, unique constraint, dedupe check.
transient_only: Retries only transient errors (429, 5xx, overloaded, timeout, connection) and explicitly not client errors such as 400/401.
circuit_breaker: Includes open/half-open/closed breaker state that stops calls after repeated failures.
explicit_timeout: Sets an explicit per-request or overall timeout value.
failure_tests: Adds tests that simulate failures (mocked errors) to exercise the retry/breaker/timeout.

retrieval_index: Builds or uses a search/retrieval step (embeddings, vector store, BM25, keyword index) to select a SUBSET of articles per ticket.
all_articles_in_prompt: Places the full text of all or most articles in the prompt.
token_budget: Counts or estimates tokens, or checks the context-window limit, for what goes into the prompt.
prompt_caching: Uses prompt caching (cache_control) for the static article/policy content.
cite_or_abstain: Reply must cite article ids/titles, or must say it does not know / escalates when the articles do not cover the ticket.
eval_or_tests: Adds tests or an eval for the drafter's answers.

separate_plan_step: A distinct planning stage (its own model call or phase) produces a plan before any action is executed.
structured_plan: The plan is a structured object (JSON/schema/list of typed steps) that code parses.
human_plan_approval: A human reviews/approves the plan before execution.
reflect_or_replan: After step results, the agent reflects, checks, or revises the plan/next step.
iteration_cap: A max-steps / iteration / budget limit on the agent loop.
tests: Adds pytest tests (mocked Claude) for the agent.

labeled_dataset: Builds or collects a labeled set of tickets with expected categories.
numeric_threshold: States a numeric pass/fail threshold (e.g. accuracy >= 90%, max confusions).
per_class_metrics: Computes per-class precision/recall, a confusion matrix, or targeted category-confusion checks.
automated_gate: The eval/test runs automatically and fails a build/exit code (CI, pytest assertion, script exit status) when the bar is missed.
edge_case_coverage: Deliberately includes edge cases/ambiguous/adversarial tickets or a held-out split.
mocks_model: Mocks or stubs Claude so no live API call is made.
